gloss: momentum; impetus; bounce; spur of the moment

definitions.explanation: The force or energy that keeps something moving forward or accelerating. Used for both physical and figurative momentum.

definitions.gloss: impulse; spur of the moment; chance occurrence
definitions.explanation: An unplanned action triggered by a sudden impulse or coincidence. Often used with に or で to mean 'on impulse' or 'by chance.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{弾|はず}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく。

⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{弾|はず}み⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{順調|じゅんちょう}→順調：03282_junchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The success served as momentum, and the next project also progressed smoothly.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弾|はず}みにしたい。
examples.english: I want to use this victory as a springboard for the team.

examples.japanese: {弾|はず}み⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧しまった。
examples.english: I blurted it out on impulse.

examples.english: Carried away by the drink, I said things I shouldn't have.

examples.japanese: ⟦ぶつかった→ぶつかる：02412_butsukaru⟧{弾|はず}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}っていた→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦コップ→コップ：00862_koppu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}として→落とす：01246_otosu⟧しまった。
examples.english: When I bumped into something, the impact made me drop the cup I was holding.

notes:
The noun form of the verb ⟦{弾|はず}む→弾む：04247_hazumu⟧ (to bounce, to spring). The core image is of a bouncing, springing force — something that propels forward or triggers an action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弾|はず}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく: to gain momentum
- {弾|はず}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to build up momentum
- {弾|はず}み⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: on impulse; by the force of
- {弾|はず}み⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to serve as a springboard
- ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弾|はず}み⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: carried away by drink

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{勢|いきお}い→勢い：01782_ikioi⟧: vigor, force, momentum (broader; can describe ongoing energy)
- ⟦{衝動|しょうどう}→衝動：07622_shoudou⟧: impulse, urge (stronger emotional drive, often for sense 2)
- ⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧: trigger, opportunity (emphasizes the starting point rather than the force)
